allowed.resources: Specifies a comma-separated list of URLs that must be trusted by the Managed File Transfer user interface for Content Security Policy.

mft_activity_log_show_filesize: Captures file size information in the activity log. Set this property to true to capture file size information in the activity log for copy task and move task.
mft_agent_event_log_activityTypes:
Especifica o que deve ser registrado para atividades do Agente.
 O valor padrão é auth, asset, event, que registra autenticação, detalhes do agente e detalhes de execução do evento.
mft_agent_user:
Speciﬁes the user name that the Managed File Transfer Agent instance uses to connect to Managed File Transfer Server.Multiple users can be entered separated by comma.
 For example: mft.agent.user=FS_agent1,FS_agent2,FS_agent6
mft_aliases_tn:
Specifies the remote server aliases for Trading Networks instances hosted on remote Integration Server hosts. These remote server aliases are defined in the Integration Server Administrator portal. 
 When synchronizing the partner details and transferring files to remote Trading Networks instances, Managed File Transfer checks this parameter to determine the remote Trading Networks instance it must connect to. 
 Use commas to separate the remote server aliases.
 For example: mft.aliases.tn=remote server alias 1,remote alias 2,remote alias 3
mft_client_connection_pool_waitForConnec:
This property allows you set the duration in seconds that Managed File Transfer must wait for connection pools to connect to the FTP or SFTP server before timeout occurs. 
Default value is 30.
mft_client_outbound_useProxy: Specifies if proxy server settings are enabled in Managed File Transfer.
mft_client_s3_upload_multipart_size:
Especifica o tamanho mínimo de cada upload em múltiplas partes em MB.
 Isso pode ser configurado para uploads paralelos ou simples.
mft_client_s3_upload_parallel:
To configure if Managed File Transfer’s S3 client uploads to S3 bucket in parallel or not.
 If set to false, Managed File Transfer's S3 client will not spawn threads for individual parts. Each write operations for upload will wait till the previous multi part uploads finishes.
 If set to true, Managed File Transfer's S3 client will spawn threads for different parts of the upload.
 Each write operations for upload will not wait till the previous multi-part uploads finishes.
mft_client_s3_upload_parallel_threads: Especifica o número máximo de threads responsável por fazer upload das peças em paralelo.
mft_client_session_cache_ttl:
Especifica o tempo em segundos para sessões de clientes a serem armazenadas em cache. Usado somente para execução de eventos. Uma sessão de cliente é desconectada e removida do cache quando esse parâmetro é excedido.
 O valor padrão é 120 segundos. Esta propriedade é usada somente quando mft.event.session.reuse é definido como true.
mft_client_sftp_ciphers_exclude: This property removes a cipher from the supported cipher list when webMethods ActiveTransfer acts as a client connecting to a remote SFTP server.
mft_client_sftp_ciphers_preferred: This property configures the preferred cipher when webMethods ActiveTransfer acts as a client connecting to a remote SFTP server.
mft_client_socket_timeout:
Especifica o limite de tempo do soquete para o soquete de dados de conexões FTP. O valor aceito está em segundos.
 O valor padrão é de 600 segundos.
mft_client_zip_extract_maxFileSize:
Specifies the maximum size of zip files to be unzipped using Unzip task. 
 The default value for this property is 10240. By default, Managed File Transfer set a limit of 10240*1024*1024bytes (10 GB) size for a zip file to unzip by Unzip task. 
 For example, if you want to set a 20GB limit, then you can set the value 20480 for this property. Managed File Transfer achieves this by multiplying the value for the property with 1024 * 1024 internally.
mft_client_zip_extract_maxFiles: Especifica o número máximo de arquivos que um arquivo zip pode conter para descompactar com a tarefa Unzip. O valor padrão é 1000.
mft_event_actions_caseSensitive: Especifica se a pesquisa de nome da ação na página de registro da ação diferencia letras maiúsculas e minúsculas.
mft_event_manual_allowStatusChange: A ação de agendamento manual está desativada por padrão. Este parâmetro permite que a ação de agendamento manual seja ativada.
mft_event_move_skipRename:
Managed File Transfer Server attempts to rename a file when the Move operation is used and the host machine is the same for the source and destination locations. 
 This adversely affects files located on two different drives.
 Set the property to false if files are moved across different drives to skip rename, copy, and delete the original file.
mft_event_scheduler_runAsUser:
Specifies the user name associated with the scheduled task whenever an Integration Server scheduled task is created by Managed File Transfer. 
The default is the Administrator. However, Managed File Transfer does not change the user while updating the scheduled task.
mft_event_scheduler_target_anyServer: This property specifies if the Integration Server scheduler for a webMethods ActiveTransfer action runs on any node or not. Set this property to "true" to run the Integration Server scheduler for a webMethods ActiveTransfer event, with "Target Node" as "Any Server". The default value is "false".
mft_event_session_reuse:
Managed File Transfer reuses the connections (sessions) to remote servers that are created by Managed File Transfer  actions. This is achieved by caching the sessions for the action and reusing them later in similar actions within the same action instance.
This parameter specifies if client sessions should be reused or not in Managed File Transfer actions.
 Also, the duration of caching a client session is determined by the property, mft.client.session.cache.ttl.
mft_group_aliases:
When more than one Managed File Transfer instances share the same database(Managed File Transfer Group), this property specifies the remote server alias for the other nodes. 
 These remote server aliases are defined in the Integration Server Administrator portal. 
 This information is used to synchronize different assets like VFS, Post-Processing Actions, Scheduled Actions across all nodes in the group.
mft_http_default_port:
Especifica a porta HTTP listener padrão.
 O valor padrão é 2080.
mft_http_default_port_secure: Especifica se a porta HTTP padrão criada no MFT tem segurança. Por padrão, a porta HTTP não é segura.
mft_isserver_host:
Specifies the Integration Server host. Provide the IP address or host name of the machine where Managed File Transfer Server is running.
 If you do not specify a host name, then 'localhost' is used. 
 Check the mft.isserver.port for configuring the port.
mft_isserver_port:
Especifica a porta do Integration Server. Informe a porta no seguinte formato: Protocol@Port. 
 Por exemplo, Protocolo é HTTP ou HTTPS, e Porta é 5555.
 O protocolo padrão é HTTP. Se você não especificar um número de porta, a porta primária do Integration Server será usada.
mft_log_sessionlog_disable:
Specifies if logging of session information should be disabled for individual user sessions.
 If you retain the default value of false, Managed File Transfer creates separate log files for each Managed File Transfer Server user session in the following directory:
 Integration Server_directory \instances\instance_name\packages\WmMFT\ resources\logs\session_logs.
  If you set this parameter to true, Managed File Transfer does not create logs for Managed File Transfer Server user sessions in the given directory.
mft_never_ban_list:
Specifies a list of IP addresses that should be excluded from the hammering settings that you configure in ActiveTransfer Server. The IP addresses listed using this property are not banned by the ActiveTransfer Server or the ActiveTransfer Gateway.
 The list is shared with ActiveTransfer Gateway, so apply this restriction only on the ActiveTransfer Server.
 Do not apply it on the ActiveTransfer Gateway.
mft_partners_useTNPartners:
Specifies if Managed File Transfer must synchronize with and use the partners configured in Trading Networks. 
 You can either use Managed File Transfer partners or Trading Networks partners, not both.
 The default value is false.
 Set this parameter to false if you want to use partners configured in Managed File Transfer.
 Set this parameter to true to use partners configured in Trading Networks.
 On changing the parameter value to true, the Managed File Transfer partners become invalid.
mft_password_change_endpoint_url: Especifica o URL padrão do endpoint HTTP(s) para a senha esquecida, ou seja, http(s)://<nome_do_host>:<porta>. Por exemplo, http://localhost:3131
mft_password_change_token_expiry: Especifica o tempo de expiração do token em horas para o e-mail de redefinição de senha.
mft_query_maxrows:
Especifica o número máximo de registros de ativos para pesquisar no banco de dados e exibir nas páginas de monitoramento.
 O valor padrão é 1000.
 Aumentar esse valor pode afetar o desempenho do sistema, pois muitos registros serão inseridos na memória do sistema para cada sessão de usuário.
mft_server_auth_rolesGroups:
Especifica se todos os logins de usuário exigem informações de Função/Grupo. 
 Defina esta propriedade como true comente quando o VFS tiver permissões para definir a função ou o grupo.
mft_server_crlUrl:
If certificate-based authentication is enforced through either the "Require valid certificate" or "Require valid certificate and password" field for FTPS (implicit or explicit) and HTTPS ports, Managed File Transfer validates the client certificate against the certificate revocation list (CRL) specified in mft.server.crlUrl to permit or block client access to Managed File Transfer Server.
 Set the value of mft.server.crlUrl as either as a file stored in an accessible directory or a file that can be downloaded from a URL.Example:
 - mft.server.crlUrl=C:/MFT/CRL/mftCRL.crl
- mft.server.crlUrl= http://softwareag.com/crls/mftCRL.crl.
 If this property is not set, Managed File Transfer does not perform the CRL check.
mft_server_dmz_cert_hostnames: Set the comma-separated hostnames that Managed File Transfer uses to validate the gateways SSL certificate's hostnames.
mft_server_dmz_exclude:
A comma-separated list of Gateway server names that must not connect from this instance.This property is useful when there are multiple server and gateway and you want to avoid crisscross connections among them. 
 Setting the accept IP list in the Gateways cannot establish the connection. 
 However, Managed File Transfer servers will continue trying to connect to all the Gateways. This property will help to avoid this scenario.
mft_server_dmz_http_upload_confirm:
Checks the connection between your Managed File Transfer Server and Managed File Transfer Gateway. 
 When set to true, Managed File Transfer Gateway verifies with Managed File Transfer Server if a file upload is successful.
mft_server_event_monitor_fileEvent_threa:
Especifica o tamanho do pool de discussão para processar eventos de arquivo para acionar as ações da pasta Monitor.
 O valor padrão é 1000.
mft_server_event_monitor_folder_cluster_: Specifies the monitor folder actions cluster refresh interval time. The default value is 10.
mft_server_event_monitor_process_subfold: Specifies the monitoring of file events in subfolders. The default value is false.
mft_server_event_monitor_threads:
Especifica o tamanho do pool de discussão para executar as ações da pasta Monitor.
 O valor padrão é 10.
mft_server_ftp_fxp_deny: Defina a propriedade como false para permitir o Protocolo de intercâmbio de arquivos em ouvintes FTP.
mft_server_ftp_list_allowEmpty:
Specifies if the error code 450 is returned for LIST command for the file names that do not exist.
 When set to true, Managed File Transfer returns an empty list and not error code 450.
mft_server_ftp_nlst_includePath: Esta propriedade é para o servidor FTP, se esta propriedade for configurada como verdadeira, será incluído o caminho do arquivo em resposta ao comando NLST.
mft_server_gateway_socket_timeout:
Specifies the timeout of a session between Managed File Transfer server and Managed File Transfer Gateway in milliseconds.
 Default value is 10000.
mft_server_http_header_verification_enab: As transações que vêm através das portas HTTPs verificam se há cabeçalhos suportados como parte do arquivo headers.txt. Se essa propriedade for ativada, essa verificação de segurança será desativada.
mft_server_http_webdav_disable: O suporte a WebDAV pode ser desativado ao configurar esta propriedade como verdadeira.
mft_server_https_auth_saml:
Especifica se o Login único pode ser ativado em HTTPS listeners.
 Se a propriedade for definida como false, a configuração do Login único nos HTTPS listeners será ignorada.
mft_server_https_auth_saml_redirecturi:
A autenticação do Login único redireciona o URL quando mft.server.https.auth.saml é definido como true.
 Todos os ouvintes são ignorados.
mft_server_import_size_max: Tamanho máximo do arquivo de origem ao importar ativos no Gerenciamento de Ativos. O tamanho máximo está em MB.
mft_server_password_complexity: Especifica a regra de complexidade de senha no regex para usuários de mft
mft_server_session_vfs_liveUpdate:
Determina se qualquer atualização do VFS está visível a todas as sessões de usuário existentes. 
 Quando o valor dessa propriedade é false, qualquer atualização nas permissões do VFS não é aplicável às sessões de usuário existentes.
mft_server_sftp_alogorithms_keyexchange_: Especifique uma lista separada por vírgula de algoritmos principais de intercâmbio que precisam ser excluídos da lista aceita de servidores SFTP.
Especifica o algoritmo de intercâmbio principal para servidores SFTP.
mft_server_sftp_auth_keyboard_prompt: Set this property to "true" to enable displaying instruction prompts during webMethods ActiveTransfer SFTP server authentication mechanism.
mft_server_ui_login_autoComplete: Define se a senha arquivada na página de login deve ser preenchida automaticamente ou não.
mft_session_replication_address:
Specifies the IP address or host name, and port details of this Managed File Transfer Server node. This property will determine the port on which the server will listen for session replication messages, when the property mft.session.replication.enable is set to true.
 The parameters are as follows:
 IP_address_node_1:port_node_1 
 IP_address_node_1 The IP address or host name of this Managed File Transfer Server node.
 port_node_1 The port number on which the session replicator is running for this node.
 For example: mft.session.replication.address=10.60.30.100:7800
mft_session_replication_enable:
Enables the replication of the HTTP user sessions across all the Managed File Transfer nodes. Replicating session information across nodes is expensive.
 Set the property to true only if HTTP listeners in Managed File Transfer Server nodes are exposed through a load balancer. Set to false if Managed File Transfer Gateway does not require session replication. 
When the property is set to true, ensure the following two properties are also configured:
mft.session.replication.address 
mft.session.replication.other.nodes
mft_session_replication_other_nodes:
Specifies the IP address or host name, and port details of the Managed File Transfer Server nodes that will form a group with this server node. The property determines all the server nodes and their corresponding session replication port for communicating the session information, when the property mft.session.replication.enable is set to true.
 The parameters are as follows:
 IP_address_ node_2[port_node_2], IP_address_ node_3[port_node_3]….IP_address_node_n[port_node_n] 
 IP_address_ node_n: The IP address of the nth node in the group.
 port_node_n: The port on which the session replicator is running on the nth node.
 For example: mft.session.replication.other.nodes =10.60.27.214[7800],10.60.28.89[7800]
mft_sftp_port_forward_allow: Determina se a porta de encaminhamento é permitida em ouvintes SFTP.
mft_sharing_account_tempdir: Specifies a temporary directory location for a file share. When the Managed File Transfer group is available, this location must be a shared file location that is accessible from all the nodes.
mft_ssl_client_acceptAnyCert:
Specifies if Managed File Transfer Server should validate the SSL certificates from a client against the certificates in its truststore and allow communication only from trusted remote servers, or accept all SSL certificates.
 The default is true. Set the value of the property to false if you want Managed File Transfer Server to accept SSL certificates only from clients that have a truststore entry.
mft_ui_security_csp_allowed_resources: Specifies a comma-separated list of URLs that must be trusted by the Managed File Transfer user interface for Content Security Policy.
mft_ui_session_timeout_minutes:
Permite que o usuário configure o tempo limite da sessão.
 Observação: o valor de 0/-1 representa um tempo limite infinito da sessão.
mft_user_email_from: Ativa a comunicação por e-mail usando o ID de e-mail De com o usuário final do sistema.
mft_user_email_public_ip:
Specifies the Managed File Transfer Server host name to use for the external server URL that is emailed to users for logging in to the server.
 If this parameter is not set, the internal IP address is used in the email. This parameter also applies to the email notifications sent for shared files.
 The shared file link contains either the Managed File Transfer Server or Managed File Transfer Gateway if the source location of the shared file is the Managed File Transfer Server VFS or Managed File Transfer Gateway.
mft_user_email_subject: Especifique a linha do assunto da mensagem de e-mail que é enviada ao usuário.
mft_vfs_tree_pagination_depth:
Quando há várias pastas virtuais, a página Virtual Folder Management leva mais tempo do que o esperado para carregar as pastas virtuais. Esta propriedade, junto com pageSize, faz a paginação na tela do VFS.
 Esta propriedade especifica a profundidade da pasta para aplicar a contagem de pastas informada na propriedade mft.vfs.tree.pagination.pageSize.
 O valor de profundidade da pasta é 1 para a pasta-raiz, 2, 3, etc, para os níveis de profundidade de pastas filhas.
mft_vfs_tree_pagination_pageSize:
When there is a large number of virtual folders, the Virtual Folder Management page takes longer than expected to load the virtual folders. This property along with mft.vfs.tree.pagination.depth will perform the pagination on Virtual folders screen. 
This property specifies the number of virtual folders to display in the Virtual Folder Management page.
 Managed File Transfer recommends a value of 300 or less. Higher values for this property might result in lengthy loading time.
  The value "-1" displays all virtual folders.
mft_web_security_csrf:
Specifies if CSRF header is added to all HTTP requests from Managed File Transfer WebClient. 
 The default value is false.
mft_web_security_httpOnly:
Specifies if the httpOnly header is added to all HTTP requests from Managed File Transfer WebClient.
 The default value is false.
mft_web_security_sameSite:
Specifies if CSRF header is added to all HTTP requests from Managed File Transfer WebClient. 
 The default value is false.
mft_webclient_change_password_disabled: This property disables the "Change password" option in the ActiveTransfer Web Client user interface. Set this property to "true" to disable the "Change password" option for users of the Web Client user interface. The default value is "false".
mft_webclient_login_forgot_password_hide: This property hides the "Forgot password" option in the Managed File Transfer Web Client login page. Set this property to "true" to hide the "Forgot password" option for users of the Web Client login page. The default value is "false".
